title: The Popcorn Chicken My Dad's Made 100,000 Times | Made With Lau
ldName: The Popcorn Chicken My Dad's Made 100,000 Times
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the chicken breast in half lengthwise, then into slices, then strips about 1/2 inches thick.
Add white pepper powder, five spice powder, garlic salt, salt, sugar, chicken bouillon, cornstarch, and water to a bowl, throw in the chicken slices, and mix by hand.
Distribute cornstarch evenly on a plate.
Blend salt, garlic salt, five spice powder, and white pepper powder in a small bowl.
Add oil to a wok, heat on high to about 350F, then turn the temperature down to medium while frying.
Set to high heat, and heat the oil to 380-400F. Fry in 2 batches, about 30 seconds each. The chicken should turn much more golden brown.
Blend the seasoning ingredients in a small bowl, and place the chicken in a mixing bowl. Gradually sprinkle the blend and toss the chicken simultaneously.
